name: signal-memory
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code that runs entirely on your machine. Your agent stores decisions, commands, gotchas and preferences as small cards, and recalls them in later sessions: ranked search, pinned standing rules, labels for how each fact is known, and a lifecycle that summarises old cards without deleting them. No account, no API key, no data leaves your computer.

full_search.title: Full search
full_search.description: Search by meaning as well as by words. Downloads about 800 MB of libraries and a 90 MB model once, in the background; until it finishes, memory uses keyword search. Turn off to stay on keyword search with no large download.
